import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Filter the dataset to find the relevant series names
relevant_series = [
    'Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)',
    'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)',
    'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)',
    'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)'
]

# Filter the dataset to include only the relevant series
df_relevant = df[df['Series Name'].isin(relevant_series)]

# Pivot the dataset to have one row per country and year
df_pivot = df_relevant.pivot(index=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], columns='Series Name', values=[col for col in df_relevant.columns if col not in ['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Series Name']])

# Reset the index to make it easier to work with
df_pivot = df_pivot.reset_index()

# Convert all columns to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df_pivot = df_pivot.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with missing values

# Split the 'Year' column into 'Series Name' and 'Year'
df_melted[['Series Name', 'Year']] = df_melted['Year'].str.split(' ', expand=True)

# Drop the original 'Year' column
